mixing_order_reasoning: From Chemistry Plan: TBHP/NaBr/H2SO4 mixed with alcohol first to form acyl intermediate; morpholine added downstream to avoid oxidation of amine.
pre_reactor_steps: No deoxygenation required (Chemistry Plan: TBHP is oxidant, O2 exclusion not required).
post_reactor_steps: No quench specified (Chemistry Plan: Not specified in batch record).
chemistry_notes: Two-stage oxidative amidation. Stage 1 (5 mL coil): Oxidation of benzyl alcohol to benzoyl bromide/acid intermediate using TBHP/NaBr/H2SO4. Stage 2 (10 mL coil): Amidation with morpholine. TBHP and morpholine are incompatible (oxidant vs amine) and must be segregated. Acidic conditions promote both steps. Thermal reaction at 80°C. No light source used. BPR recommended precautionarily due to operating temperature (80°C) being within 30°C of dioxane boiling point (101°C), despite calculation indicating it is not strictly required.
